issues.title: findAimTarget calls getMaxRange on an item that is not a weapon
issues.note: Its OnPlayerUpdate handler keeps looking for a tank to shoot while an attack is under way, even when the item in the hand is not a firearm; findAimTarget then calls weapon:getMaxRange(), which only weapons have. The Studio's shim answers no target when the hand holds no ranged weapon (patch propane_explosion). Reproduced and checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30.
issues.log: ERROR: General f:188498> Lua((MOD:Propane Explosion)).findAimTarget> Exception thrown java.lang.RuntimeException: Object tried to call nil in findAimTarget
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, checked in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30)
